assessment.title: Circuit Studio — two guided practice examples
assessment.instructions: Untimed practice. Save locally and download JSON. Practice is not a graded submission.

questions.title: Example 1: Edit a resistor and measure voltage
questions.promptHtml:
Learn the circuit tools

This example uses a 1 V source, R₁ = 2 kΩ, R_f = 10 kΩ and R_L = 2 kΩ.

  1. Click Edit circuit. Use the mouse to select R_f. Open its properties (double-click if needed) and change its value to 4 kΩ.
  2. Click Measure DC. Find the output node voltage. The input is +1 V, the summing node is approximately 0 V, and the output should be approximately −2 V.
  3. Close the measurement window. Click Capture evidence to record your modified circuit.
  4. Open Final answers and enter your resistor value, measured output and explanation below. You can also use Text, Equation or Pen in the Solution canvas to show work.

Self-check: For an ideal inverting amplifier, gain = −R_f/R₁ = −4/2 = −2. Thus v_out = −2 V. The measurement is a check of your reasoning, not an automatic grade.

responseFields.label: Enter R_f, measured output voltage, and your gain calculation.

questions.title: Example 2: Change the load, record evidence and save
questions.promptHtml:
Learn evidence capture and saving

This is a separate starting circuit: 1 V input, R₁ = 2 kΩ, R_f = 10 kΩ and R_L = 2 kΩ. Changes in Example 1 do not carry over.

  1. Click Edit circuit, then Measure DC. The output should be approximately −5 V. Expand the detailed results to inspect branch currents.
  2. Change R_L from 2 kΩ to 1 kΩ. Measure again and click Capture evidence.
  3. In Final answers, explain why the ideal output remains −5 V while the load-current magnitude doubles from 2.5 mA to 5 mA. Current signs depend on the reference direction.
  4. Click Finish & Save and accept the confirmation. A practice JSON file downloads automatically. Find it in Downloads.
  5. Use Restart practice to repeat both examples. For the actual quiz, upload its downloaded JSON file to Canvas; this practice file is labeled PRACTICE and is not Quiz 1.

Self-check: |I_L| = |v_out|/R_L. Halving R_L doubles |I_L| for this ideal amplifier.

responseFields.label: Record output before/after, load-current magnitudes and your explanation.
